 Jensen Huang: China alone masters both factories and code
 Video 
 16:33, 26-Oct-2026
 Share 
 Copied
 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said China's edge is timing, as its economic transformation unfolded during the computer age. Huang made the comment during a recent discussion with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz on China's industrial strengths. He told Merz that, “China is probably the only nation today that is deep in manufacturing and deep in computer science and very comfortable in both.”
